title: Car taking a bend (বাঁক নেওয়া গাড়ি)
placement: Book page 36, topic 2.2: চলন গতি (Translational Motion), next to that paragraph, after the translational-motion lab: the contrast to the book's সোজা এগিয়ে যাওয়া গাড়ি (the page has no picture for it).
description: Detailed pearl-white 3D car with red accents on a plain curved street (asphalt road, footpaths with kerbs, soft earth and sky, nothing else; real size, metres) for the contrast in চলন গতি (translational motion), book page 36, topic 2.2: the book's example is a car going straight ahead, so a car taking a bend is not translational. Four painted, labelled points on the body (front bumper, rear corner, window, roof). The student drags the car or presses চালাও: the car takes a quarter turn (rear axle radius 5 m) and each point leaves a bold outlined trail with an arrowhead along its own circle; the panel shows how far each point went (10.4 ≠ 9.4 ≠ 8.0 ≠ 9.3 m) and ✗ চলন গতি নয়. Test tab: 3 questions (is the bend translational, which point went farthest, which motion is translational with look-alike pairs), each worked answer naming the student's mistake. Phone-first, Bangla.
